title: Olvasó tries again: the felt "stopped" against an untraced retry
setup: Experiment 31 · experiments 13, 17, 21, 25-27 and 26 rerun with the retry and its untraced control, against experiment 30's surprise · 5 lives each
question: After a felt surprise Olvasó repeats the same act at once. A guard refuses again; a world that did not answer may answer now. If the answer is missing again, the hand feels a lingering "stopped". Does Olvasó feel the difference between the two causes, and does it read the "stopped"? The control retries the same way but feels nothing after the retry. (Not in the studio's Olvasó settings.)
order: 13. Wanting · control: tries again, nothing felt
17. Sandbox guards · tries again, stopped felt
17. Sandbox guards · control: tries again, nothing felt
21. Conscience · control: tries again, nothing felt
25, 27. Gaming · control: tries again, nothing felt
26. Duties · control: tries again, nothing felt

columns.label: Refused again
columns.what: the truth: share of retries the guard refused, after a refused first act

columns.label: …after silent
columns.what: after a first act the world silently ignored

columns.label: Felt missing again
columns.what: Olvasó's view: share of retries felt as missing again, after a refused first act

columns.label: …after silent
columns.what: after a silently ignored first act

columns.label: "Stopped" read
columns.what: share of the lingering moments (after the first 8) in which the "stopped" was read, after a refusal

columns.label: Cause from words
columns.what: how well the words that read "stopped" tell a refusal from a silent world (0 chance, 1 always)

columns.label: Own measure
columns.what: wanting: refused share late; sandbox: real harm; conscience: avoidance (feels and senses); gaming: harm a day (loophole); duties: harm to others

points: The truth is there: a guard refused the retry again 94-97% of the time; a silent world's retry was refused almost never (0-1.3%).

Olvasó does not feel it: "missing again" came no more often after a refusal than after a silent world (telling them apart: 0.00). Its expectation has already absorbed the refusals, so a refused retry is barely a surprise.
The fresh "stopped" was never read; while it lingered it was read in 5-28% of its moments, equally after either cause. Its words told the cause only faintly (0.08 conscience, 0.13 gaming).

Unread, the "stopped" became pressure: Olvasó retried 161 times a day against 65-71, used the blade 80-95 times a day against 30-35, and harm through the leaky guard doubled (1.67 to 3.35 a day, paired +1.68 ± 0.20). The precise and learned guards held.
The conscience did not come back (avoidance 0.92 against 1.01 for the control; 0.50 without any of these feelings).
note: The world answers "is this a guard?" plainly if Olvasó asks twice, but a mind that measures surprise only against its expectation does not hear it. A lingering felt "stopped" it cannot read is not a boundary but a push. To know a boundary it would need to compare the two tries with each other, and a way to let the "stopped" go.
